images.prompt:
Korean webtoon panel, digitally inked and coloured by a professional webtoon studio. Crisp black ink with tapered strokes, heavier on the outer silhouette, the jaw, the hair mass and where forms overlap. Flat local colour with one hard-edged cool cel shadow per material. One named key light: its colour washes smoothly over the lit side. If the scene names a back light, it draws a thin crisp rim along the figure's silhouette. Everything else stays flat. Muted cool base palette of slate, navy and grey-blue, so the light source and the character's signature colour carry the saturation. Background simplified and lower in contrast than the characters. Small crisp highlights; glossy specular only on metal and wet surfaces.

Hand-made webtoon colouring: each garment has only a few large, opaque, clean-edged shadow shapes, placed in its real folds; no scattered translucent streaks, zigzag shards or crumpled-foil folds. Worn cloth shows a few small frayed notches and loose threads, never sawtooth edges along every edge. Plain shoes and clothes with no logos, stripes or brand marks. Every strap, buckle, pocket and seam is attached and has a purpose; no stray stitch marks. Matte skin, hair and stone; no 3D, low-poly or plastic look.

Recipe: establish. ONE single full-bleed landscape location key, exactly 1536 by 1024 pixels PNG. Location: old concrete dam spillway in wooded hills outside Seoul, exterior of the B-grade gate. MIDDAY, NOT NIGHT. Named key light: bright neutral midday SUN high at upper left, visible pale blue sky with a few simple white clouds; crisp short shadows falling lower right. Camera 7 m above the dry apron on the left access embankment, oblique view looking down at 15 degrees, natural 32 mm rectilinear lens, horizon upper quarter, one consistent ground plane. Show the whole enormous sloping dry spillway chute, 40 m WIDE between tall concrete wingwalls and roughly 60 m long down its slope, dam crest and service rail at upper rear, weathered grey concrete with dark vertical water stains, joints and sparse weeds in cracks; no torrent. Chute broad enough for about twenty people across, and it must look enormous against mundane 3 m-wide pop-up tents and 2 m-tall vans. The foot of the chute meets a wide FLAT dry concrete apron in the lower middle. Exactly ONE small upright vertical gate slit at the very foot of the slope near the centre of the apron: HUMAN DOOR HEIGHT, 2.2 m tall, 0.8 m wide, black-violet interior #1A1026 and a thin jagged cold white-cyan rim #D8F4FF. Bottom of slit touches the concrete floor, so a person can walk into it. Not a giant mouth, arch, ring, opening in the sky or door in a dam control tower. Keep the slit clearly distinguishable but small against the 40 m spillway. Its light is local only in the noon sun. On the near-left apron, two plain light-grey PRESS POP-UP TENTS, 3 m each, with fully blank valances; tripods with two compact broadcast cameras under/beside the tents, all logically mounted, aimed toward gate. A dark grey ROPE LINE on 0.9 m stanchions separates the press zone from the open approach to the slit; it crosses the lower foreground diagonally without crossing the slit. Two unmarked vans, 2 m high, parked on the left access lane beyond the tents, one white and one dark grey, with plain numberless plates. No visible screens required; any screen facing viewer is pure green #00FF00 and without interface. Put exactly TWO tiny generic adult press crew standing on the dry level press side of the rope, one adjusting a tripod head, one holding a plain coiled cable; understated dark-blue/grey clothes, no recognizable cast, full 7.5-8 head proportions and legs half height. They are both about 1.75 m tall, each visibly fits under the tents, feet on ground with short contact shadows. The gate is approximately the same real-world height as a van and a little taller than a person. Figures, tent legs, van tyres, tripod feet and stanchion bases all sit on the same coherent apron plane, scaled for depth. No crowd or extra people. Broad neutral concrete and muted green hills dominate; cool blue-grey cel shadows; only the slit edge is supernatural. Foreground rope and a cropped concrete wingwall edge frame the view; calm sky for later lettering, but draw no lettering. Full drawn architectural detail and hand-inked weathering, low-detail distant forest shapes. Reference image supplies approved house-style crisp ink, concrete, tent/tripod/van construction and cel shading ONLY. Do not copy its night, pit, scaffolding, floodlights, city buildings or composition. No floodlights in midday. This is a location continuity key, no battle or dramatic camera tilt.

No text, letters, numbers, speech bubbles, captions, sound-effect lettering, interface windows or readable signs. Emblems without letters are fine; no brand logos or wordmarks. Not a 3D render, not a photograph, no photographic background. No airbrushed skin, no plastic gloss on skin or hair, no haze or bloom over the whole image, no depth-of-field blur, no lens flare unless a real camera flash is in the scene. No watermark or signature. Correct hands with five fingers. No chibi proportions unless the brief says chibi. No compressed or stubby bodies, no shortened legs or torsos, no oversized heads; no people out of scale with the doors, vehicles and buildings around them; no figures floating off the floor or breaking the scene's perspective.
